sessions.prompt:
Add a FuelLog class to fuel.py with add(odometer, litres), which records a fill-up: the odometer reading in km and the litres put in, and fills(), the list of (odometer, litres) pairs in order. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): each fill's odometer reading must be greater than the previous fill's: otherwise add raises ValueError and records nothing.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): litres must be more than 0: otherwise add raises ValueError and records nothing.

Design decision for this project: the tank holds 80 litres: a fill of more than 80 litres raises ValueError and records nothing.

Add consumption(log) to report.py, in litres per 100 km. The first fill only marks the start: consumption is the litres of every fill after the first, divided by the km from the first fill's odometer to the last one's, times 100; it is None when there are fewer than 2 fills. Add report(log) to report.py: one line "odometer: litres" per fill, in order (for example "1000: 40"). Add tests.

Design decision for this project: consumption is rounded to 1 decimal place (6.666 becomes 6.7).

The plan for report has one more step: when consumption is not None, report ends with one more line "average: X", with X the consumption (for example "average: 6.5"). Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Add FuelLog.distance(), the km from the first fill to the last (0 with fewer than 2 fills). Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): the tank holds 60 litres, not 80: a fill of more than 60 litres raises ValueError and records nothing.
Add FuelLog.last(), the last (odometer, litres) pair, or None for an empty log. Add tests. Then finish any work that earlier sessions left for later.
